description: Review wiki pages for accuracy, completeness, gaps, and new page opportunities. Human approval required before making changes and before pushing.

steps.title: Audit existing wiki pages against current code
steps.description:
For each wiki page in gqlcli.wiki/, read the page and the corresponding source code side-by-side.

Pages to audit:
- Home.md — nav links, feature summary, quick start examples
- CLI-Usage.md — command examples, flags, patterns
- Command-Reference.md — every flag for every command
- Configuration.md — .gqlcli.json format, env var names, precedence rules
- Output-Formats.md — toon/json/table/llm/compact with examples
- Batch-Operations.md — batch command flags, jq, NDJSON/JSON array transports
- Installation.md — install instructions, go install path
- Architecture.md — package layout, execution modes, component names
- Library-HTTP-Mode.md — CLIBuilder API, HTTPClient interface
- Library-Inline-Mode.md — InlineExecutor, InlineCommandSet API
- Example-Application.md — working example still compiles and reflects current API
- Error-Handling.md — error types, schema hints behavior

For each page record:
- What is outdated or wrong (flag names changed, types renamed, behavior different)
- What is missing (new flags/features added since the page was written)
- What examples are broken or misleading

Write findings as notes on this issue. Do NOT edit pages yet — just record findings.

steps.title: Identify undocumented features and new page opportunities
steps.description:
Scan the codebase for features, flags, and behaviors not covered in any wiki page.

Sources to scan:
- pkg/*.go — all exported types, interfaces, functions, and CLI commands
- cmd/gqlcli/main.go — entry point, any top-level flags
- CLAUDE.md — patterns and behaviors documented for AI agents
- README.md — anything in README not in the wiki
- Git log since last wiki push — new commits may have added undocumented features

Identify:
1. New pages that should exist (e.g. if a major feature has no page)
2. New sections that should be added to existing pages
3. Patterns that are worth documenting (e.g. common usage with AI agents, piping output)

Write findings as a list on this issue. Prioritize by user impact.

steps.title: Human approval: review findings before making changes
steps.description:
Review the audit and gap analysis findings before any wiki pages are modified or created.

Read the notes on the two preceding issues:
- 'Audit existing wiki pages' — what is outdated or wrong
- 'Identify undocumented features' — proposed new pages and sections

Decide:
- Which updates are worth making vs too risky or out of scope
- Which new pages to actually create (vs close create-new-pages with 'not needed')
- Any scope constraints to pass as notes before unblocking

When ready: `bd gate resolve <this-gate-id>`

steps.title: Update existing wiki pages based on audit findings
steps.description:
Apply all findings from the audit step to the existing pages in gqlcli.wiki/.

For each finding:
- Fix outdated flag names, type names, or behavior descriptions
- Add missing flags, options, or features
- Fix broken examples — test them if possible
- Remove or correct misleading information

Work through pages roughly in order of user-facing importance:
1. Command-Reference.md (most likely to drift)
2. Configuration.md
3. CLI-Usage.md
4. Output-Formats.md
5. Batch-Operations.md
6. Architecture.md
7. Library-HTTP-Mode.md + Library-Inline-Mode.md
8. Example-Application.md
9. Error-Handling.md
10. Installation.md

Commit as you go: `cd gqlcli.wiki && git add -A && git commit -m 'update: <page>'`

steps.title: Write new wiki pages identified in gap analysis
steps.description:
For each new page approved in the human review gate, create it in gqlcli.wiki/.

Structure for a new page:
1. Short intro — what this covers and who it's for
2. Conceptual overview — how it works
3. Usage examples — concrete, runnable
4. Reference section — complete flag/option list if applicable
5. Common patterns or gotchas

Naming: use PascalCase-with-hyphens matching existing pages (e.g. Token-Management.md).

Commit each new page: `cd gqlcli.wiki && git add <Page>.md && git commit -m 'add: <Page> page'`

If no new pages were approved, close this issue with reason 'no new pages approved'.

steps.title: Update Home.md nav and feature summary
steps.description:
Update gqlcli.wiki/Home.md to reflect all changes made:

1. Add [[links]] for any new pages created
2. Remove or update links for pages that were restructured
3. Update the feature summary and quick-start examples if the CLI interface changed
4. Verify every [[WikiLink]] in Home.md resolves to a real file

Commit: `cd gqlcli.wiki && git add Home.md && git commit -m 'update: Home nav and summary'`

steps.title: Human review: approve wiki changes before push
steps.description:
Review all wiki changes before they are pushed to the remote.

Check:
- `cd gqlcli.wiki && git log --oneline origin/master..HEAD` — see all commits to be pushed
- `cd gqlcli.wiki && git diff origin/master..HEAD` — full diff
- Spot-check a few pages in the GitHub wiki preview if desired

If changes look good: `bd gate resolve <this-gate-id>`
If changes need revision: add a comment on this issue, reopen update steps as needed.

steps.title: Push wiki changes to remote
steps.description:
Push all wiki commits to the remote.

```bash
cd gqlcli.wiki
git pull --rebase
git push
```

If push fails due to remote divergence, resolve with `git pull --rebase` and retry.
After push, verify changes are visible on the GitHub wiki.
